accepted.name: tract_basic_demographics
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  geo_id,
  total_pop,
  male_pop,
  female_pop,
  median_age,
  white_pop,
  black_pop,
  asian_pop,
  hispanic_pop,
  not_hispanic_pop,
  amerindian_pop,
  other_race_pop,
  two_or_more_races_pop
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
accepted.description: One-row-per-tract basic demographic and population measures. Use this to select tract-level population, sex, age and primary race/Hispanic counts for filtering, joins, or aggregations. | Use for: Filter tracts by population thresholds or demographic composition; Join demographics to housing or income CTEs by geo_id; Aggregate population counts by external groupings (county/state) after join

accepted.name: tract_housing_and_rent_profile
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  geo_id,
  housing_units,
  vacant_housing_units,
  vacant_housing_units_for_rent,
  vacant_housing_units_for_sale,
  households,
  owner_occupied_housing_units,
  mortgaged_housing_units,
  million_dollar_housing_units,
  median_rent,
  percent_income_spent_on_rent,
  rent_under_10_percent,
  rent_10_to_15_percent,
  rent_15_to_20_percent,
  rent_20_to_25_percent,
  rent_25_to_30_percent,
  rent_30_to_35_percent,
  rent_35_to_40_percent,
  rent_40_to_50_percent,
  rent_over_50_percent,
  rent_burden_not_computed
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
accepted.description: One-row-per-tract housing and rent-burden related measures. Use for housing analysis, rent-burden thresholds, vacancy and owner-occupancy studies. | Use for: Compute tract-level rent burden shares or identify high-burden tracts; Estimate vacancy rates or owner-occupancy rates across areas; Join to demographic CTEs to study correlations between rent burden and population

accepted.name: tract_income_measures
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  geo_id,

  median_income,
  income_per_capita,

accepted.name: rent_buckets_unpivoted
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  geo_id,
  'under_10_percent' AS rent_bucket,
  rent_under_10_percent AS bucket_count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
UNION ALL
SELECT geo_id, '10_to_15_percent' AS rent_bucket, rent_10_to_15_percent AS bucket_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
UNION ALL
SELECT geo_id, '15_to_20_percent' AS rent_bucket, rent_15_to_20_percent AS bucket_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
UNION ALL
SELECT geo_id, '20_to_25_percent' AS rent_bucket, rent_20_to_25_percent AS bucket_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
UNION ALL
SELECT geo_id, '25_to_30_percent' AS rent_bucket, rent_25_to_30_percent AS bucket_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
UNION ALL
SELECT geo_id, '30_to_35_percent' AS rent_bucket, rent_30_to_35_percent AS bucket_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
UNION ALL
SELECT geo_id, '35_to_40_percent' AS rent_bucket, rent_35_to_40_percent AS bucket_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
UNION ALL
SELECT geo_id, '40_to_50_percent' AS rent_bucket, rent_40_to_50_percent AS bucket_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
UNION ALL
SELECT geo_id, 'over_50_percent' AS rent_bucket, rent_over_50_percent AS bucket_count FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`

grain: geo_id, rent_bucket (one row per tract per rent bucket)
accepted.description: Unpivot tract-level rent buckets into long form: one row per tract per rent_bucket with the count/estimate for that bucket. Useful for bucket-level aggregations, charts, or computing share of renters in each bucket. | Use for: Compute share of renters in each rent bucket per tract or aggregated across tracts; Create visualizations of rent burden distribution; Filter tracts where a particular bucket exceeds a threshold

accepted.name: tract_mortgage_and_value_flags
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  geo_id,
  housing_units,
  owner_occupied_housing_units,
  mortgaged_housing_units,
  million_dollar_housing_units,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(owner_occupied_housing_units, NULLIF(housing_units, 0)) AS owner_occupancy_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(million_dollar_housing_units, NULLIF(owner_occupied_housing_units, 0)) AS high_value_owner_share
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
accepted.description: Normalize and expose owner/mortgage/value related derived flags and rates: owner_occupancy_rate and high_value_owner_share. Keeps one row per tract with explicit flag columns for downstream filtering. | Use for: Filter tracts by owner occupancy or high-value owner share; Compute correlations between high_value_owner_share and median_income; Aggregate owner_occupancy_rate across areas after join to geography
